title: Open Tire Limit per Vehicle Class — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
The tires already open on a vehicle are aggregated across all of its Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty sets before a new ticket is written. The open tires are the total tire count over the vehicle's sets in status ordered or active on the purchase date. The open tires plus the new ticket's tire count must not exceed the limit for the vehicle's class:

| Vehicle class | Most tires open on the vehicle |
|---|---|
| Passenger car | 4 |
| SUV/CUV | 5 |
| Minivan | 4 |
| Light truck | 5 |
| Commercial van | 5 |
| Medium-duty truck | 6 |

Tires being taken off the vehicle in exchange for the new ones still count until the set they belong to is closed, so when a purchase replaces every tire of an older set that older set is retired first and only then is the new ticket opened; when a purchase replaces only some positions of an older set, the older set stays active and the limit is checked on the sum. Tires on returned, cancelled, worn-out or retired sets never count.

**Cases (hypothetical vehicles):**
- A passenger car with one active set of 2 tires may take a new ticket of 2 tires (2 plus 2 is 4) but not 3.
- An SUV/CUV with an ordered set of 4 tires may take a ticket of 1 more tire, reaching 5.
- A minivan whose only earlier set is in status returned has 0 open tires.
